items.name: Carrot Ginger Soup
steps: Wash and cut the carrots, sliced into even pieces.
Warm the olive oil; bloom the cumin and soften the additional fresh ginger and fennel seeds.
Add the main ingredients and water, bring to a boil, then lower to a steady simmer.
Cook until everything is completely tender; mash or blend all of the soup to give the broth body.
Add the rock salt, simmer for three more minutes, and serve warm.
items.guidance: Carrot Ginger Soup is a vegetable-forward soup served warm with a fully cooked texture. Vata: serve warm, cook until tender, and add a little ghee if the dish feels dry. Pitta: moderate chilies and sharp sourness, favoring coriander or fennel. Kapha: keep the portion light, reduce added fat, and favor ginger or black pepper.

Add the main ingredients and fresh thyme; stir to coat them evenly.
Pour in the water, add the rock salt, and simmer covered until the legumes or grains are soft and the vegetables are tender.
Uncover and reduce only until the broth lightly coats a spoon, then serve warm.
items.guidance: Tofu Mushroom Stew is a moist, slowly simmered international main. Vata: serve warm, cook until tender, and add a little ghee if the dish feels dry. Pitta: moderate chilies and sharp sourness, favoring coriander or fennel. Kapha: keep the portion light, reduce added fat, and favor ginger or black pepper.

items.name: Fennel Red Lentil Soup
steps: Wash and cut the red lentils and fennel bulb, sliced and carrot, diced into even pieces.
Warm the olive oil; bloom the cumin and soften the fennel seeds.
Add the main ingredients and water, bring to a boil, then lower to a steady simmer.
Cook until everything is completely tender; mash or blend part of the soup to give the broth body.
Add the rock salt, simmer for three more minutes, and serve warm.
items.guidance: Fennel Red Lentil Soup is a vegetable-forward soup served warm with a fully cooked texture. Vata: serve warm, cook until tender, and add a little ghee if the dish feels dry. Pitta: moderate chilies and sharp sourness, favoring coriander or fennel. Kapha: keep the portion light, reduce added fat, and favor ginger or black pepper.
